entries:
Oh! Hey!
{VAR 0100 0000}, right?{VAR BE01}

Staggering! You've seen a Klink!
You're becoming quite the Trainer.{VAR BE01}

In honor of our meeting,
I'm going to upgrade your Pokédex!{VAR BE01}

{VAR 0100 0000}'s Pokédex has
been upgraded!
???: Professor, who's that Trainer?{VAR BE01}

See you, Skyla. If something comes
up again, I'll let you know!{VAR BE01}

Planes! Their shapes!
They are perfectly designed to fly!{VAR BE01}
There is no excess in the
mechanics for flying!

The only planes that fly out of
Mistralton Airport are cargo planes.{VAR BE01}
If Trainers want to fly, they can go
with a Pokémon that knows the move Fly.

Skyla's grandfather was
a legendary Pilot.{VAR BE01}
Skyla is our city's Gym Leader.
She's a really nice person!

I hear many people have had their
Pokémon stolen by Team Plasma...
Oh! You found our treasure!{VAR BE01}
Found it!{VAR BE01}
Yoooo-ooou can uuu-uuuuuse it!{VAR BE01}
See you! Bye-bye!{VAR BE01}
